apps.name: Git + GitHub CLI
apps.description: Installs git and the GitHub CLI (gh) into the workspace and provides a settings panel for gh login (token or web flow — the token is stored in the zero-knowledge secret store, never in plain config).

apps.name: AWS CLI
apps.description: Installs the AWS CLI v2 into the workspace and provides a settings panel for AWS credentials (access key, secret key, region, session token — applied via `aws configure`, secret fields routed to the zero-knowledge secret store).

apps.name: Essential CLI Tools
apps.description: Installs a set of essential CLI tools into the workspace — telnet, ping, curl, nc, perl, python — and keeps them present across restarts. No login/settings/secrets, pure command install.

apps.name: Homebrew
apps.description: Installs Homebrew into the workspace via a non-root git-clone method (the official installer requires sudo/root, unavailable in this container) and keeps it present across restarts. No login/settings/secrets, pure command install.

apps.name: Node.js Dev
apps.description: Installs a Node.js dev toolkit into the workspace — nvm, Node.js (LTS by default), npm, npx, and yarn/pnpm via corepack — and keeps it present across restarts. No login/settings/secrets beyond the Node version to install.

apps.name: Terraform
apps.description: Installs Terraform (single Go binary) into the workspace and keeps it present across restarts. No login/settings/secrets beyond the Terraform version to install.

apps.name: AW Browser
apps.description: Runs a managed headless Chromium instance (CDP remote-debugging endpoint) as a service — start/stop lifecycle, journaled install, autostarts on activate. MVP exposes the CDP endpoint (ws://.../json/version) driveable by Playwright/CDP clients; chromedriver/Selenium WebDriver is phase 2.

apps.name: Presentations
apps.description: HTML presentations created by agents (diffs, reports, dashboards) — top-bar gallery nav + a viewer window. Nav/view registration is blocked on a framework capability not shipped yet (see repo README); backend routes/WS are live.

apps.name: Whiteboard
apps.description: Persistent, live-synced HTML canvas — set/patch content, broadcast changes to every open viewer over a WebSocket, round-trip with a presentation. Nav/view registration is blocked on a framework capability not shipped yet (see repo README); backend routes/WS + agent-piloted browser are live.
